plugin.name: Backups
plugin.description: Back up folders, databases and Docker data on your hosts with restic, then browse, download and restore.

use.title: Use Backups
use.description: Set up backup jobs and repositories, run backups, and browse, download and restore snapshots on hosts they can edit.

hostTab.title: Backups
hostTab.sudo: Termix needs to log in as root, or as a user with passwordless sudo, to run backups on this host.

install.missing: restic is not installed on this host
install.tooOld: restic on this host is older than 0.17
install.hint: Backups use restic. Install it with the package manager, or from the restic release on GitHub when the package is too old.
install.title: Install restic?
install.desc: This installs restic on the host as root.

jobs.emptyHint: Add a job to back up folders, databases or Docker data.
jobs.emptyNoRepo: Add a repository first, so backups have somewhere to go.
jobs.loadFailed: Could not load the backup jobs

editor.name: Name
editor.noRepos: You have no repository this host can use. Add one in the Backups tab first.
editor.repoLocked: Only the owner of this repository can change it.
editor.enabledHint: Turn off to pause the schedule. Run now still works.
editor.oneFileSystemHint: Skip other disks and mounts found inside the picked folders.
editor.deleteDesc: The job is removed from Termix. Its snapshots stay in the repository.

sources.excludesHint: One restic pattern per line, like *.log.
sources.noDatabasesPlugin: Turn on the Databases plugin to pick a saved login.
sources.passwordSaved: Saved, leave empty to keep it
sources.runAsHint: A Linux user to run the dump as, like postgres. Empty runs it as root.
sources.databasesHint: One name per line. Leave empty to back up all of them.
sources.sqliteFilesHint: One full path per line. Each file is copied safely while it is in use.
sources.dockerFailed: Could not list Docker on this host
sources.stopHint: Picked stacks are stopped first and started again after, so their files don't change while they are read.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.cronHint: Minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week.
schedule.manualHint: This job only runs when you press Run now.

keep.title: Keep
keep.hint: After each backup, older snapshots of this job are removed so only these are kept. All 0 keeps everything.

hooks.title: Commands
hooks.preHint: Runs as root before the backup. If it fails, the backup stops.
hooks.postHint: Runs as root after the backup, even when it failed. TERMIX_BACKUP_STATUS holds the result.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.onFailureHint: Also alerts on warnings, and once when it works again.
alerts.staleDaysHint: Alert when no backup worked for this many days. 0 turns it off.

repos.emptyHint: A repository is where backups are stored, like an S3 bucket or a folder.
repos.name: Name
repos.endpointHint: Empty for AWS. For MinIO, R2, B2 or Wasabi, their S3 address.
repos.secretSaved: Saved, leave empty to keep it
repos.usernameHint: Empty when the server has no login.
repos.rcloneHint: The lines of the remote from rclone.conf. Run rclone config on your computer to make them. rclone must be installed on the hosts.
repos.rcloneSaved: Saved, leave empty to keep it
repos.folderHint: Only jobs on this host can use it. A mounted disk is best.
repos.passwordHint: Leave empty and Termix makes a strong one. Keep a copy somewhere safe: without it the backups can't be read.
repos.passwordKeep: Saved, leave empty to keep it
repos.passwordChangeHint: This only changes what Termix sends. It does not change the password of an existing repository.
repos.revealDesc: Anyone who has it and the storage keys can read every backup in this repository. This is written to the audit log.
repos.checkFromHint: The host that opens the repository. It needs restic.
repos.created: The repository was set up and is ready.
repos.checkNext: Saved. Check it from a host to set it up.
repos.deleteDesc: It is removed from Termix only. The backups stay in the storage.

snapshots.deleteDesc: The snapshot from {{time}} is removed from the repository for good.

restore.title: Restore
restore.hostHint: Any host you can edit that can reach the repository.
restore.localOnly: This repository is a folder on its host, so it can only be restored there.
restore.folderHint: Files keep their full path inside this folder.
restore.originalWarning: Files are written back to where they were and may replace what is there now.

overwriteOptions.if-newer: Replace when the backup is newer

run.title: Run
run.stopDesc: A stopped backup saves no snapshot. A stopped restore leaves the files restored so far.

showPanel.label: Show backups panel in terminals
showPanel.description: Let the backups panel open beside this host's SSH terminal.

companionAutoOpen.label: Open the backups panel with new terminals
companionAutoOpen.description: Show the backups panel beside every SSH terminal that has it turned on. You can still open and close it from the button on the right edge.

companionSide.label: Backups panel side
companionSide.description: Where the backups panel sits next to a terminal.

companionSize.label: Backups panel size
companionSize.description: Width in pixels, or height when it is at the bottom. You can also drag its edge.

companionEdgeButton.label: Show the panel button
companionEdgeButton.description: Show a small button on the right edge of a terminal that opens the backups panel.
